subject: LuminaHealth onsite demo — heads-up about travel change / fallback options
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Dr. Elena Soto <elena.soto@luminahealth.org>, Tom Berger <tberger@luminahealth.org>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-08T09:15:00-08:00
Subject: LuminaHealth onsite demo — Nov 12 / agenda + prep

Hi Elena / Tom,

Thanks again for the time slot confirmation last week — per our calendar I had Nov 12 penciled in for an on-site walkthrough at Lumina’s San Jose office. I pulled together a short agenda (attached) and a proposed mutual action plan (MAP) to guide next steps if this demo is a fit. Attachments: lumina_demo_agenda_v2.pdf, proposed-MAP.xlsx.

Quick ask: can you confirm whether the clinical team will be present live or via a dial-in? If we have the clinicians, we’ll prioritize the workflow demo and integration touchpoints; if they’re remote we’ll tighten to a 30–40 minute focused session and follow with an async recording + Q&A.

Tentative agenda highlights (brief):
- 15 min: clinical workflow and integrations
- 10 min: performance/cost discussion (hosted vs. dedicated)
- 10 min: next steps / MAP alignment

If the Nov 12 window still works, I’ll block the room and bring the kit. If anything changes on your end, please flag and we’ll propose alternates.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com
(415) 555-0146

--
Attachments: lumina_demo_agenda_v2.pdf (PDF), proposed-MAP.xlsx (XLSX)

From: Dr. Elena Soto <elena.soto@luminahealth.org>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Berger <tberger@luminahealth.org>
Date: 2026-11-08T11:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: LuminaHealth onsite demo — Nov 12 / agenda + prep

Hi Neha,

Quick update — my travel got scrambled this morning. My connecting flight into SJC was rebooked and I’m not landing until early on Nov 14 now, so I won’t be able to attend in person on Nov 12. Apologies for the short notice.

Options that work for us:
1) Move the onsite to Nov 16 (I’ll be back in town and can make the afternoon)
2) Keep Nov 12 as planned but shorten to a 30-minute drop-in with our IT lead (Dr. Patel) and have me join asynchronously (watch the recording + join the Nov 16 office-hours Q&A)

If you can send the integration checklist and a short security snapshot up front that would help our IT triage while I’m traveling.

Tom (cc) is helping with logistics.

Thanks,
Elena
Dr. Elena Soto
Chief Medical Officer, LuminaHealth
elena.soto@luminahealth.org

--
Note: asked for security snapshot and integration checklist

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Dr. Elena Soto <elena.soto@luminahealth.org>, Tom Berger <tberger@luminahealth.org>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-08T12:04:00-08:00
Subject: Re: LuminaHealth onsite demo — Nov 12 / agenda + prep

Thanks for the heads-up, Elena — appreciate the flag.

We can do either option; here’s a suggested fallback to keep momentum without forcing travel changes:
- Keep Nov 12 as a 30-minute in-person drop-in for the IT/ops stakeholders (11:00–11:30 PT) — we’ll record the session.
- I’ll send an async recording and the short security snapshot now (attached) so you and your team can triage while you’re in transit.
- Schedule a 45-minute office-hours check-in on Nov 16 (4:00–4:45 PT) — live Q&A + deeper MAP alignment (I’ll have Priyom host the tech portion).

Priyom — can you host the Nov 16 office-hours and confirm you can cover any in-depth integration questions if Elena is remote? Also attaching proposed-MAP.xlsx for your reference.

Action items for Lumina: confirm whether Dr. Patel will be the in-person point on Nov 12 and whether 11:00–11:30 PT works.

Neha

--
Attachments: security-snapshot-README.pdf, proposed-MAP.xlsx

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Dr. Elena Soto <elena.soto@luminahealth.org>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Tom Berger <tberger@luminahealth.org>
Date: 2026-11-08T13:18:00-08:00
Subject: Re: LuminaHealth onsite demo — Nov 12 / agenda + prep

I can host Nov 16 office-hours (4:00–4:45 PT) and will prepare a 10–15 min tech deep-dive on integrations (FHIR connector, EMR sync, and data retention). If Elena prefers, I’ll also capture a short runbook we can attach to the recording so engineering has a single place for next steps.

Backup contact for the session: priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com (in case I’m pulled into another call).

I’ve attached the MAP again with a tentative engineering owner column filled out.

— Priyom
Principal Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
priyom.das@redwoodinference.com

--
Attachments: proposed-MAP.xlsx

From: Dr. Elena Soto <elena.soto@luminahealth.org>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Berger <tberger@luminahealth.org>
Date: 2026-11-08T15:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: LuminaHealth onsite demo — Nov 12 / agenda + prep

Neha, Priyom — thank you, that plan works.

We’ll keep Nov 12 as the short in-person drop-in (11:00–11:30 PT) with Dr. Patel and our IT lead; I’ll review the security snapshot en route and flag anything that needs clarification. Please include the short integration checklist in the recording description so our SRE can start mapping endpoints.

I’ll plan to join the Nov 16 office-hours for the Q&A.

One more ask: can Redwood provide a short note on SOC2 scoping for hosted vs dedicated options (high level bullet list) — we’ll need that for procurement.

Thanks and safe travels,
Elena

--
Quick acceptance and request for SOC2 scoping note
